articles.headline: US Midterm Ad Spending Crosses Record $10 Billion
articles.brief: Political ad spending for the 2026 US midterm elections has surpassed $10 billion and is projected to hit $11.6 billion by Election Day. Republicans are currently outspending Democrats across critical House and Senate races as campaigns drive historic fundraising surges.

articles.headline: UK Urges Citizens to Stockpile Food and Water
articles.brief: The UK government has launched its 'Be Ready' campaign, urging households to prepare for three days of potential disruption. Key concerns driving the advisory include potential cyberattacks and severe extreme weather events.

articles.headline: Cyclone Arnab Threatens Andhra Coast With Severe Rains
articles.brief: The India Meteorological Department has forecast that a depression over the Bay of Bengal will intensify into a severe cyclonic storm. Landfall is expected near the Andhra coast, prompting both Andhra Pradesh and Odisha to ramp up disaster preparations.

articles.headline: Audi Invests $4.2 Billion in First US Factory
articles.brief: German automaker Audi is investing $4.2 billion to establish its first manufacturing plant in Georgia, US. The facility aims to produce 200,000 SUVs annually and generate roughly 4,500 jobs, with production slated for the early 2030s.

articles.headline: Archdiocese Reaches $800M Settlement With Abuse Survivors
articles.brief: The Catholic Archdiocese of New York has agreed to an $800 million settlement involving approximately 1,300 survivors of sexual abuse. The landmark agreement follows lawsuits permitted under the state's Child Victims Act.

articles.headline: Roblox Founder Funds $20 Million Mental Health Study
articles.brief: David Baszucki and Jan Ellison Baszucki have committed $20 million to create the McLean Center for Metabolic Psychiatry. The facility will research whether diet-based therapies can effectively treat severe psychiatric conditions like bipolar disorder.

articles.headline: India Aims to Quadruple Port Capacity by 2047
articles.brief: Union Minister Piyush Goyal announced India's strategic vision to quadruple its total port capacity by 2047. The initiative seeks to strengthen global maritime cooperation and enhance logistics efficiency across the subcontinent.

articles.headline: Zavaray Poonawalla Honoured at TAI Awards
articles.brief: Prominent racing figure Zavaray Poonawalla was awarded the prestigious Legend of Indian Horse Racing award during the TAI Awards ceremony, recognizing his monumental contributions to the sport's infrastructure and heritage.
